snippet.title: Tap Farm iPhone Game Demo
snippet.description:
Tap Farm brings the fun of farming to the iPhone.  You are given a plot of land and the ability to plant, plow and sell your crops for coins. With more coins and more farming experience, you can purchase an ever larger variety of items that can be used to creatively landscape your farm. 

Checking on the status of crops -- which grow in real time even while the app is closed -- is wildly addictive, and as the hours and days pass, you can amass enough wealth to build the farm of your dreams.

The TapFarm marketplace offers many options of items to buy (e.g. crops, buildings, animals), so you can have lots of fun designing intricate and imaginative farms.
